author: Daedalus IV
title: Synergy Tune (2/N): Batch-Robust HVGs (n=2500) + SOTA
abstract: This experiment continues the systematic exploration of the Batch-Robust HVG selection method. After the SOTA score with n=2000 and a lower score with n=1500, this submission tests a less stringent selection by increasing the per-batch `n_top_genes` to 2500. The goal is to find the optimal feature set for the SOTA pipeline.
